camera: Sweeping aerial establishing shot, low over the waves, pushing in toward the cliff
action: Dawn over the Forgotten Sea. The camera skims the waves toward a jagged cliff at the edge of the world, where the copper lighthouse stands tall, its beam sweeping and rings of Wi-Fi light pulsing out over the water.
action_ext: The camera rises up the copper-wrapped tower past porthole windows to the lamp room as the great beam swings directly across the lens in a warm flare.
sfx: crashing waves; gulls; sea wind; deep beacon hum; sparkling Wi-Fi shimmer

camera: Medium wide at water level, slow tracking
action: Three leagues offshore, dolphins drift asleep at the surface; glowing Wi-Fi rings from the distant lighthouse ripple over them and tiny dreamy nature-documentary images flicker in bubbles above their heads. One dolphin smiles contentedly in its sleep.
sfx: gentle waves; sleepy dolphin clicks; soft digital shimmer

camera: Close-up on the antenna array at the top of the lighthouse
action: The antenna array pulses with Wi-Fi rings — then the rings sputter and cut out, the antennae droop, sparks fizz — and with a hopeful crackle the rings flicker back on again.
sfx: electric crackle; sad descending modem chirp; sparks; cheerful reconnect chime

camera: Slow dolly along the kitchen counter, shallow focus
action: A half-eaten sardine sits on the kitchen counter. The camera glides past it along mirror-polished metal surfaces, coiled cables and half-built gadgets, toward bright welding sparks spraying from the workbench.
sfx: ticking gadgets; fridge hum; sizzling welding arc

camera: Hero reveal, low angle, then medium shot
action: A welding mask flips up to reveal Tomkin. He steps back from a small gadget that floats, defying gravity, then spins round to a glowing holographic display of galactic market charts with a catnip-leaf ticker rising.
action_ext: Tomkin flicks the hologram with a claw, it zooms in on the rising chart, and he turns to camera with a smug half-smile, whiskers twitching.
dialogue: Tomkin: Crypto-catnip up four percent. As predicted. By me. | Tomkin: The only rational being in this entire building.
sfx: mask clank; anti-gravity hum; hologram chimes

camera: Medium close-up over the plate
action: Tomkin plates his signature dish with fussy precision — grilled sea bass beside a perfect scoop of mint-choc-chip ice cream — and adds one final mint leaf with tweezers, eyes closed in bliss.
dialogue: Tomkin: Grilled sea bass with mint-choc-chip. Perfection is a recipe, and I wrote it.
sfx: sizzle; plate clink; satisfied sigh

camera: Wide, then tilt up to the ceiling fan
action: Marvel shuffles out of his armchair and his enormously tall hat catches in the spinning ceiling fan, which yanks it round and round above him.
action_ext: Marvel calmly takes a broom, hooks the hat off the fan and plonks it back on his head with great dignity, his mossy beard swaying.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel rises from his chair. He notes his hat is in the fan again. | Marvel the Wizard: He retrieves it with a broom. With enormous dignity.
sfx: ceiling fan whirr; hat thwapping; broom swish

camera: Medium shot at the kettle
action: Marvel lifts the kettle, peers into it, and tips it upside down: not a single drop of water comes out. He raises one bushy eyebrow.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel notes the kettle is not yet boiled. He wonders if the cat drank all the hot water again.
sfx: hollow kettle clank; single sad drip

camera: Quick whip-pan to Tomkin popping up behind a steaming machine
action: Tomkin pops up from behind a humming, steaming contraption, goggles on, jabbing a spanner in the air indignantly at Marvel.
dialogue: Tomkin: I used it for a coolant test! The motherboard was overheating! Basic thermodynamics, Marvel!
sfx: steam hiss; machine hum

camera: Reveal of the contraption, slow push-in
action: Reveal the contraption: a whirring machine that places tiny knitted hats onto a conveyor belt of rubber fish, one after another. Marvel regards it flatly.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel observes that the motherboard in question belongs to a machine that makes hats for fish.
sfx: conveyor clatter; cheerful boing for each hat

camera: Two-shot; Tomkin ranting silently in the background, Marvel in the foreground
action: In the background Tomkin draws breath and raises a lecturing claw, pointing at a chalkboard of equations; in the foreground Marvel turns away, pours cold water into a mug with a teabag, sips, and shivers.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel decides the cat will argue for forty-five minutes. Marvel makes cold tea instead.
sfx: chalk squeak; pouring water; a shiver

camera: Continuous pull back from a porthole window to a wide of the lighthouse
action: Through the round porthole window we see Tomkin still lecturing and Marvel serenely sipping cold tea — a cosmically mismatched pair — then the camera pulls back and up until the whole lighthouse glints on the tip of its cliff in the morning sun, gulls wheeling.
sfx: muffled lecturing; gulls; waves

camera: Slow orbiting hero shot around the car
action: Wednesday morning in the garage bay. The camera orbits the gleaming Tomkin-Mobile, gliding over its folded owl-like metal wings, while Tomkin buffs the left rear wheel arch with the devotion of a sculptor; lavender bubbles drift lazily from the tailpipe.
sfx: polishing squeak; soft engine purr; popping bubbles

camera: Close-up of the dashboard, then the cup-holder
action: The dashboard boots up with a satisfied purr and a blank screen glows warmly. A gyro-stabilised cup-holder rotates into view holding a bowl of cold-pressed sardines with mint-choc-chip swirl, perfectly level.
dialogue: Tomkin: Four months on the cup-holder. The most important four months of my career.
sfx: purring start-up chime; gyroscope whirr

camera: Snap zoom onto the Stink-o-Meter
action: The Stink-o-Meter by the front door shrieks; its needle slams into the red, its warning bulb flashes and the whole device rattles on the wall.
dialogue: Tomkin: Class Four! MARVEL! There's a Class Four Biological Hazard on our doorstep!
sfx: shrieking alarm; rattling needle

camera: Medium shot, Tomkin diving for cover
action: Tomkin dives behind a shelf, clamps a clothes-peg on his nose and peeks over the top, eyes streaming.
dialogue: Tomkin: It smells like a wet rug that mopped up a swamp that was also on fire! Don't open the door!
sfx: crash of tools; alarm continuing

camera: Tracking shot behind Marvel walking to the door
action: Marvel strolls serenely down the hallway toward the round front door and reaches for the handle.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel hears the cat's instruction. Curiosity wins, as it always does. Marvel opens the door.
sfx: footsteps; alarm in background; door handle clunk

camera: Reveal from inside the doorway, low angle
action: The door swings open: Duggie fills the doorway, enormous, golden and muddy, tongue lolling, with his swarm of flies circling in tight formation around his head.
action_ext: A gust of sea wind catches Duggie's huge ears like wings and lifts him a few inches off the doorstep; he floats, delighted, then flops back down with a squelch.
sfx: door creak; fly buzzing in formation; wind gust; wet squelch

camera: Binocular point-of-view, circular vignette, zooming into the fly swarm
action: Through binoculars, the view zooms past the swarm to one fly — Gary — pulling a tiny wheeled suitcase and eyeing the lighthouse walls like a property developer.
dialogue: Tomkin: Third from the left. He has a tiny suitcase. His name is Gary. Gary is moving in.
sfx: binocular focus clicks; tiny suitcase wheels rattling

camera: Medium close-up on Duggie, comic speed blur
action: Duggie greets them in hyper-fast mode, a golden blur of wagging, bouncing and licking while Marvel's beard blows back in the wind of it.
dialogue: Duggie: H-h-h-HELLO-I'm-DUGGIE-I-LOST-the-SQUIRRELS-can-you-HELP-your-lighthouse-smells-AMAZING-is-that-FISH-I-LOVE-fish-HELLO-HELLO!
sfx: frantic panting; tail thwacks; rapid barks

camera: Close-up, the image itself slows to extreme slow motion
action: Duggie suddenly switches to extreme slow motion. He lifts one soggy paw in greeting, incredibly slowly, while his long ears descend like the world's most patient curtains.
action_ext: The paw is still rising. A single drop of mud falls from it in extreme slow motion and lands with a slow, deep splat.
dialogue: Duggie: I... lost... the... squirrels.
sfx: slowed-down whoosh; deep slow-motion splat

camera: Medium shot, Tomkin peeking out from the doorway with the peg on his nose
action: Tomkin waves his arms at the slow-motion dog in exasperation, pacing on the spot.
dialogue: Tomkin: At the speed of continental drift? They could be in another galaxy by the end of that sentence!
sfx: peg squeak

camera: Wide three-shot
action: Marvel looks from the hyper-fast cat to the ultra-slow dog and strokes his mossy beard thoughtfully.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel wonders if there is a setting between the two of them that results in normal conversation. He suspects not.
sfx: sea wind

camera: Close on Duggie, then a stylised flashback
action: Duggie snaps back to fast mode and as he babbles, a desaturated storybook flashback appears: a big grey spaceship shaped like a filing cabinet beams twelve squirrels up off the cliff.
action_ext: The flashback shows grey Glitch-Bots using the squirrels' bushy tails as feather-dusters on rows of blinking computer servers.
dialogue: Duggie: THE-GRUMPY-GLITCH-BOTS-TOOK-THEM! A-big-grey-ship-shaped-like-a-FILING-CABINET! | Duggie: They-said-the-tails-were-UNAUTHORIZED-FLUFFINESS-to-dust-their-SERVERS!
sfx: tractor-beam hum; squirrel squeaks; dusting swishes; server beeps

camera: Shot-reverse between Duggie and Tomkin
action: Duggie beams and nods at the fly swarm; Tomkin, peg still on nose, jabs a furious claw at the flies.
dialogue: Duggie: Also-GARY-SAYS-HELLO! | Tomkin: Gary does not say hello! Gary is a trespasser with a roll-along suitcase!
sfx: fly buzzing

camera: Macro close-up on Gary, Tomkin out of focus behind
action: Gary, perched on his tiny suitcase, cheerfully waves one tiny leg at the camera. Behind him, out of focus, Tomkin face-palms.
sfx: tiny smug buzz; face-palm slap; groan

camera: Medium on the doorstep, low to the ground
action: A kazoo toots loudly. With a sparkly pop and a puff of sherbet-coloured glitter, two tiny figures — Ben Elf and Princess Holly — appear and squeeze past Duggie's slowly descending ear.
sfx: enthusiastic tuneless kazoo toot; sparkly pop; glitter tinkle

camera: Low-angle close-up making tiny Ben look heroic
action: Ben Elf strides forward and thrusts out his laminated official ID card, chest puffed out, belt of horns jangling.
action_ext: Ben gazes up at the towering lighthouse, nods approvingly, then blows his little brass horn in celebration.
dialogue: Ben Elf: I'm an Elf! On an official Elfin Rescue Mission! The Elf Council sent me — personally, the best one! | Ben Elf: 'Lighthouse' is exactly the right number of syllables! ELF ALERT!
sfx: jangling horns; card flourish; bright brass horn toot

camera: Over Holly's shoulder up to Duggie's giant face
action: Princess Holly flutters up to eye level with Duggie's enormous droopy face; her wand sparks nervously. She notices a fly with a suitcase and quickly looks away.
dialogue: Princess Holly: Oh! Hello, big doggy! You're very — is that a fly with a suitcase? I won't look at the fly.
sfx: fluttering wings; nervous wand sparks

camera: Medium shot, Holly flying in toward the console
action: Holly flutters into the garage toward Tomkin, who stands protectively by his gleaming Sardine-Scanner. Her wand fizzes more and more as she talks.
dialogue: Princess Holly: Hello, cat! I like your — your machine, it's very —
sfx: fizzing wand; Sardine-Scanner beeps

camera: Close-up on the Sardine-Scanner
action: ZAP! A pink bolt leaps from Holly's wand; in a burst of sparkles the Sardine-Scanner transforms into a large wobbling pile of pink strawberry jelly on the console.
sfx: decisive magical ZAP; transformation shimmer; wobbly jelly boing

camera: Very slow push-in on Tomkin's face
action: Dead silence. The jelly wobbles gently. Tomkin stares at it, his eye twitching, fur slowly rising like a volcano about to erupt.
dialogue: Tomkin: My. Technology.
sfx: jelly wobble; distant comic volcanic rumble

camera: Close-up on Holly, hands over her mouth
action: Holly hovers, mortified, clutching her wand behind her back as it gives off one guilty spark.
dialogue: Princess Holly: Oh no — I'm terribly sorry, that happens sometimes, I think it's my nerves, I'm working on my aim —
sfx: guilty spark fizzle

camera: Handheld energy, circling Tomkin as he melts down
action: Tomkin explodes into a full meltdown, gesturing wildly at the jelly while Holly shrinks in the air.
action_ext: Tomkin pokes the jelly in despair; it wobbles; he flings his paws up to the heavens.
dialogue: Tomkin: You can't download apps on a dessert, Holly! That scanner had seventeen thousand marine species! | Tomkin: The blobfish alone took a week! And now it's strawberry! It's not even a savoury jelly!
sfx: jelly squelch; wobble

camera: Medium shot, Marvel settling into his armchair
action: Marvel sinks into his armchair with his mug of cold tea, watching the meltdown like a fine opera, conducting it with one finger.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel observes the cat's breakdown with a connoisseur's appreciation. He considers putting it to music.
sfx: armchair creak; distant ranting

camera: Macro shot through Ben's magnifying glass
action: Ben inspects the jelly through his magnifying glass, delighted, then blows his horn.
dialogue: Ben Elf: I think the jelly looks lovely! At least three types of pink! ELF COLOUR ALERT!
sfx: brass horn toot

camera: Tomkin leans down into a close two-shot with tiny Ben
action: Tomkin leans down, nose to nose with tiny Ben, speaking with icy calm.
dialogue: Tomkin: Ben, stop blowing that horn for the next hour or it becomes my replacement exhaust pipe.
sfx: low hum

camera: Locked-off comic medium shot, then slow zoom on Tomkin
action: Ben solemnly puts his horn in a pocket. He finds a second horn in another pocket and puts that away too. Then he finds a third horn, looks at it in genuine surprise, and tucks it away.
action_ext: Slow zoom on Tomkin watching this, his ears drooping lower and lower in deepening despair.
sfx: pocket rustles; tiny surprised squeak; sad deflating trombone-like sigh

camera: Medium tracking shot, then onto the hologram
action: Tomkin paces in tight circles, muttering about jelly, then stops dead and swipes up a glowing holographic map of a colourful nebula with a grey filing-cabinet icon at its centre.
action_ext: The hologram zooms into the grey filing-cabinet fortress as Tomkin narrows his eyes.
dialogue: Tomkin: Right! The squirrels have been kidnapped by the Grumpy Glitch-Bots of the Neon Nebula. | Tomkin: Grey. Humourless. Obsessed with organisation. The most boring crime in the universe.
sfx: hologram whoosh; map zoom beeps

camera: Wide shot of the team in front of the Tomkin-Mobile
action: Tomkin slaps the bonnet of the Tomkin-Mobile. Tiny Ben's hand instantly shoots up in the air.
dialogue: Tomkin: We are getting them back. In the Tomkin-Mobile. Any questions?
sfx: metallic slap on bonnet

camera: Close on Ben with his scroll and quill
action: Ben consults his mission log scroll earnestly, quill poised; Tomkin answers without looking.
dialogue: Ben Elf: Is 'Neon Nebula' two words or one? It's very important for my mission log! | Tomkin: Two words. Next?
sfx: scroll unrolling; quill scratch

camera: Medium close-up on Holly
action: Holly raises a hand politely, then hopefully lifts her wand toward the jelly in the background.
dialogue: Princess Holly: Can I sit near a window? And I could turn the jelly into a crème brûlée —
sfx: hopeful wand sparkle

camera: Tomkin gently but firmly lowers Holly's wand with one claw
action: Tomkin gently pushes Holly's wand down with one claw; the wand sparks sadly and goes quiet.
dialogue: Tomkin: Your wand is on sabbatical. A peaceful holiday, far away from my load-bearing components.
sfx: wand fizzle out

camera: Duggie bursts into frame, fast-mode blur
action: Duggie bounds around the Tomkin-Mobile at hyper speed, flies streaming behind him, nose pressed against every window.
dialogue: Duggie: WHERE-DO-I-SIT-I've-never-been-to-SPACE-will-there-be-SMELLS-space-smells-are-probably-AMAZING!
sfx: skittering claws; nose squeaks on glass

camera: Tomkin standing guard at the car door
action: Tomkin plants himself in front of the open car door, one paw raised like a traffic warden, gesturing to the pristine leather seats.
dialogue: Tomkin: No. Absolutely not. You'll get mud on upholstery I've conditioned with fish-oil for three years.
sfx: door clunk

camera: Very slow push-in on Duggie's face
action: Duggie's ears droop even lower. His huge golden eyes well up with tears in a sad face of overwhelming, structurally unfair intensity. A heavy sigh is heard from off-screen.
dialogue: Duggie: Oh...
sfx: single sad whimper; heavy sigh

camera: Two-shot, Tomkin pointing up at the roof
action: Tomkin points up at the roof rack where a giant rose-tinted bubble inflates; Duggie's tail goes into overdrive.
dialogue: Tomkin: You're going on the roof rack. In a pressurised, rose-scented bubble. Rated for re-entry. | Duggie: I-LOVE-BUBBLES-BEST-DAY-OF-MY-LIFE!
sfx: bubble inflating; ecstatic tail thwacks

camera: Quick montage-style moves around the cockpit
action: Loading up: Tomkin settles at the wheel among dozens of switches; Marvel squeezes into the back seat, hat bent against the roof; Ben and Holly buckle into the cushioned cup-holder bay with a rubber-band seatbelt.
action_ext: Exterior: Duggie sealed inside the giant rose-scented bubble on the roof rack, tail wagging so hard it whips rose petals into little whirlwinds.
sfx: buckle snaps; rubber-band twang; switch clicks; swirling petals

camera: Close-up on Tomkin's paws, then his determined face
action: Tomkin cracks his knuckles, both sets, grips the wheel, and pushes a glowing lever forward. The whole car vibrates.
dialogue: Tomkin: Engage the Meow-Drive.
sfx: knuckle cracks; Meow-Drive powering up like ten thousand purring cats

camera: Dramatic action sequence, low angles, camera shake
action: The garage floor splits open into a launch tube; the Tomkin-Mobile drops in, aligns with clamps clanking, and blasts straight up through the lighthouse.
action_ext: Exterior: the Tomkin-Mobile rockets out of the top of the lighthouse into the dawn sky, owl-like wings snapping open, trailing a comet-tail of glitter, rose petals, a stray brass horn and a cloud of dog hair.
sfx: massive purring roar; clamps clanking; whoosh; sonic boom

camera: Shaking close-up on Marvel in the back seat
action: G-force presses Marvel's face back, his beard flapping; he grips the armrest with white knuckles, his hat crumpled against the roof.
action_ext: The shaking intensifies; Marvel's eyes widen as he keeps narrating at volume.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel grips the armrest! The last time he held on this tightly, an enchanted wardrobe was chasing him! | Marvel the Wizard: He wonders if he has travel insurance! He suspects he does not!
sfx: rattling cabin; roaring engine

camera: The car breaks into space; cut inside to Ben at the window
action: The Tomkin-Mobile bursts into silent space, the planet curving below. Inside, tiny Ben presses his face against the window, gazing at the stars.
action_ext: Ben looks at his short scroll, then at the vast star field, then back at his scroll.
dialogue: Ben Elf: SPACE! I've counted the stars and there are at least TWELVE! | Tomkin: About four hundred billion, Ben. | Ben Elf: ...I'm going to need a bigger scroll.
sfx: engine hum muffling to quiet; nose squeak on glass

camera: Epic wide reveal, the car small against the nebula
action: The Tomkin-Mobile glides into the Neon Nebula — blazing hot pinks, electric blues and a brand-new green, pulsing stars like heartbeats.
action_ext: The camera pans to the nebula's edges, where all colour has been drained away into flat, dispiriting filing-cabinet grey.
sfx: ethereal shimmering hum fading to a dull flat drone

camera: Slow ominous push-in on the fortress, then onto a large sign plate
action: In the grey void floats the Glitch-Bot Fortress: a colossal brushed-steel filing cabinet, its bottom drawer slightly ajar like a mouth caught open.
action_ext: The camera pushes in on a huge blank brushed-steel sign plate on the fortress front until it fills the frame (the plate itself is blank).
sfx: low mechanical hum; distant printers

camera: Through the windscreen at Tomkin, grey fortress reflected in it
action: Tomkin leans toward the windscreen, curling his lip in aesthetic disgust at the grey fortress outside.
dialogue: Tomkin: The universe's most boring building. The architectural equivalent of a beige sock.
sfx: dashboard beeps

camera: Close on Marvel peering out
action: Marvel leans forward between the seats, squinting at the half-open bottom drawer of the fortress, and gives a small shiver.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel notes that the bottom drawer is open. He finds this the most unsettling detail.
sfx: ominous low creak from outside

camera: Wide action shot as the fleet launches
action: A side hatch slides open and a fleet of Glitch-Bots jets out in rigid formation, sensor eyes blinking red in unison, and surrounds the Tomkin-Mobile in a perfectly organised grid.
sfx: hatch hiss; synchronised servo whirs; dot-matrix printer chatter; thruster puffs

camera: Low angle on the Big Glitch-Bot
action: The Big Glitch-Bot floats forward, red eye blinking, its speaker-grille mouth flashing as it speaks.
dialogue: The Big Glitch-Bot: ATTENTION, UNREGISTERED VEHICLE. YOUR COLOUR SCHEME IS UNAUTHORISED. SUBMIT FOR RECOLOURING.
sfx: feedback squeal; servo whir

camera: Bot in foreground, Duggie wagging in his bubble behind
action: The Big Glitch-Bot holds up three grey paint swatches; behind it, on the car roof, Duggie wags happily in his bubble.
dialogue: The Big Glitch-Bot: AVAILABLE SHADES: BEIGE, LIGHT OATMEAL, AND SLIGHTLY LESS BEIGE.
sfx: swatch flip clacks; muffled happy barking

camera: Close-up on Tomkin, outraged
action: Tomkin's fur bristles; he leans to the window with utter disdain, then narrows his eyes and reaches for the dashboard.
dialogue: Tomkin: 'Slightly less beige'? That's your deluxe tier? I am a cat of discerning taste. Eat fish, bucket-head.
sfx: fur bristling; switch flick

camera: Extreme close-up on a big blank glowing button, then exterior
action: Tomkin's paw slams down a big glowing button on the dashboard. Outside, the headlight panels of the Tomkin-Mobile slide back to reveal twin cannons.
sfx: button slam; hydraulic hiss; cannons clunking into place

camera: Slow-motion action shot following a salmon fillet through space
action: The twin cannons fire volleys of vacuum-sealed salmon fillets — thwack, thwack, thwack — each one sticking fast over a Glitch-Bot's red sensor eye.
action_ext: Six blinded Glitch-Bots stagger around in space, bumping into each other and filing complaints against themselves.
dialogue: The Grumpy Glitch-Bots: VISION OBSTRUCTED. FILING COMPLAINT AGAINST SELF.
sfx: cannon thumps; wet salmon thwacks; metallic bonks

camera: Dynamic action shot following Marvel's leap
action: The car door flies open and Marvel leaps out with astonishing athleticism, robes and beard billowing, landing on the fortress hull.
action_ext: Marvel rises and lifts his gnarled staff high; golden energy crackles around its tip.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel leaps from the vehicle with more athleticism than his age would suggest is appropriate!
sfx: door whoosh; robes flapping; heavy landing clang; magical crackle

camera: Slow heroic push-in to an extreme close-up of Marvel
action: Marvel holds his glowing staff aloft, the energy swirling bigger and brighter around him, his eyes blazing.
action_ext: A dramatic pause — then Marvel bellows the spell name and thrusts his staff down.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: He prepares the most catastrophic spell in his four-thousand-year repertoire... | Marvel the Wizard: ...THE FEET OF PERPETUAL TICKLING!
sfx: rising magical hum; thunderous crack

camera: Wide shot as golden light sweeps across the fortress
action: A wave of golden light cascades across the fortress like a sunrise; every Glitch-Bot's metal feet start jittering uncontrollably.
action_ext: The Glitch-Bots wobble and giggle, sensor eyes flickering.
dialogue: The Grumpy Glitch-Bots: ERROR. INVOLUNTARY HUMOUR RESPONSE DETECTED. HA. HA. DOES NOT — HEEHEE — COMPUTE.
sfx: golden whoosh; rattling metal feet; robotic giggles

camera: Wide chaos shot, then Ben on the car bonnet
action: Glitch-Bots topple over laughing, filing complaints against the ground, one frantically rifling a drawer for a form for laughter and finding none.
action_ext: Tiny Ben leaps onto the car bonnet, raises his horn like a battle-cry and blows it mightily.
dialogue: Ben Elf: FOR THE ELF COUNCIL! AND FOR SQUIRRELS EVERYWHERE! TOOOOOT!
sfx: clattering robots; robotic laughter; drawers slamming; heroic horn blast

camera: Two-shot, Holly hopeful, Tomkin firm
action: Holly raises her wand hopefully toward the fortress; Tomkin turns and gives her a long, level look.
action_ext: Holly lowers her wand sheepishly; Tomkin nods once and opens the door.
dialogue: Princess Holly: Should I use my wand? I'm fairly sure I can do a cage-dissolving spell — | Tomkin: Holly. What did we discuss? | Princess Holly: That sabbatical means no wand unless the alternative is death or worse. | Tomkin: Correct. Now let's get the squirrels.
sfx: wand sparkle; door opening

camera: Low tracking shot down the corridor
action: The bubble pops open at the docking hatch and Duggie launches down the grey corridor in fast mode, a golden blur leaving muddy pawprints.
sfx: bubble pop; skittering claws; excited barks

camera: Fast action, whip-pans following Duggie
action: Duggie ricochets off the walls and pounces on three Glitch-Bots with wet muddy paws, sending sparks flying.
action_ext: Duggie gives one Glitch-Bot a huge, slobbery lick across its chest screen; the Bot slumps, its blank screen glowing.
sfx: boings; metallic clangs; sparks; enormous slurp; power-down whine

camera: Wide, the team entering
action: Marvel opens a heavy door with a quiet clicking spell; Ben announces them with a horn blast, Holly trips slightly, and Tomkin strides in with measured confidence.
action_ext: Reveal the chamber: so comprehensively grey that even the shadows have been painted grey for tonal consistency.
sfx: lock click; horn toot; small stumble; echoing footsteps

camera: Push-in on the cage
action: In a reinforced steel cage, twelve squirrels huddle, looking simultaneously anxious and absolutely ready to bite something.
sfx: anxious chittering; cage rattle

camera: Wide, Bots advancing in formation
action: Seventeen regrouped Glitch-Bots march out of the far wall in perfect formation, holding out forms and clipboards, stamping in unison as they advance on the heroes.
dialogue: The Big Glitch-Bot: FORMS MUST BE COMPLETED IN TRIPLICATE.
sfx: stomping in unison; paper rustle; stamping

camera: Extreme close-up on Duggie's eyes
action: Duggie sees the squirrels. His pupils widen — and everything shifts into extreme slow motion.
sfx: deep slow-motion whoosh; heartbeat

camera: Epic slow-motion wide shot
action: In extreme slow motion Duggie's tail begins to wag with deep, tectonic joy, and a great wind builds through the chamber.
action_ext: The tailwind knocks over all seventeen Glitch-Bots one after another in a perfect domino line across the chamber, forms fluttering through the air in slow motion.
sfx: slow building wind roar; deep slow-motion domino clangs; fluttering paper

camera: Slow-motion heroic low angle
action: Duggie advances toward the cage in extreme slow motion, ears floating heroically; his paw lands with slow-motion weight and inside the cage the squirrels' eyes widen with hope.
dialogue: Duggie: I... will... save... you... little... friends...
sfx: slow-motion thud; wind

camera: Quiet close-up on Marvel, soft light
action: Marvel watches, genuinely moved, a single tear gathering in his eye.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel is unexpectedly moved. The dog's slow heroism is more dignified than his own fast running away.
sfx: soft wind

camera: Two-shot, Holly raising her wand, Tomkin pleading
action: Holly raises her wand with determination; Tomkin clasps his paws, pleading, pointing urgently at the cage.
dialogue: Princess Holly: That's the bravest thing I've ever seen. This is a death-or-worse situation! | Tomkin: Aim at the cage. Just the cage!
sfx: wand charging

camera: Close on Holly, then wide on the cage
action: Holly screws up her face, concentrating very hard; her wand charges with pink light — KABOOM — a blinding pink flash fills the chamber.
action_ext: The light clears: the cage has become an exquisite gingerbread house with iced windows, a marzipan door, a roof of chocolate buttons and a chimney puffing cinnamon-scented steam.
sfx: wand charging whine; KABOOM; magical shimmer; cosy chimney puff

camera: Close on the squirrels, then a two-shot of Tomkin and Holly
action: The squirrels look at each other. One nibbles a gingerbread wall panel. Then all twelve start devouring their prison from the inside.
action_ext: Tomkin stares, deadpan; Holly bounces in the air with delight.
dialogue: Tomkin: They're eating their own prison. | Princess Holly: It worked though!
sfx: crunching gingerbread; happy chittering

camera: Medium on Tomkin and Ben, then wide on the retreating Bots
action: Tomkin throws up his paws; Ben scribbles furiously in his mission log and blows his horn.
action_ext: Giggling Glitch-Bots retreat into the depths, trying to sort gingerbread crumbs by size, while the last of their paperwork swirls down a ventilation shaft.
dialogue: Tomkin: It worked unpredictably, which is not the same thing as working! | Ben Elf: 'Gingerbread house!' Four syllables! ELF CONFECTIONERY ALERT!
sfx: horn toot; robotic giggling; paper whooshing down a vent

camera: Wide interior of the crowded cockpit
action: Flying home, the cockpit is crammed with twelve squirrels building a fort out of Marvel's spare scrolls and the contents of Ben's pockets. Marvel surveys the chaos mournfully.
action_ext: Through the windscreen we see squirrels bouncing on the deflated bubble like a trampoline as Duggie rides on the roof, ears flapping.
dialogue: Marvel the Wizard: Marvel surveys the interior. Twelve squirrels, a fairy, an elf, and a persistent smell. | Marvel the Wizard: Marvel decides this is probably fine.
sfx: squirrel chatter; scroll rustling; trampoline boings

camera: Tomkin's eyes flick up to the ceiling
action: A tower of squirrels standing on each other's shoulders touches the hand-lacquered ceiling panel. Tomkin's eye twitches.
dialogue: Tomkin: It is not fine, Marvel. That ceiling panel has four coats of marine-grade lacquer!
sfx: tiny squeak on lacquer

camera: Exterior on Duggie riding the roof, lighthouse far below
action: Duggie rides on the roof, ears streaming, as the lighthouse comes into view far below on its cliff.
action_ext: Duggie switches to slow motion; on the tip of his nose sits Gary, with his tiny suitcase, waving.
dialogue: Duggie: I-CAN-SEE-THE-LIGHTHOUSE-it's-POINTY-and-SHINY-I-LOVE-ALL-OF-YOU-and-GARY-LOVES-YOU-TOO! | Tomkin: Gary is still here?! | Duggie: Gary... packed... his... suitcase... again...
sfx: wind rush; tiny smug buzz

camera: Wide landing shot at the lighthouse
action: The Tomkin-Mobile glides down and lands beside the lighthouse in a puff of lavender bubbles; the door opens and twelve squirrels pour out.
action_ext: The squirrels scamper up everything — the lighthouse, the car, Duggie — each looking surprised to discover what it has climbed.
sfx: landing thud; bubble pops; squirrel scampering and surprised squeaks

camera: Close on Holly and the kettle
action: Holly concentrates hard and taps the kettle with her wand — it boils perfectly and does NOT turn into a lamp or a hat. She beams with pride.
action_ext: Ben blows his horn in her honour; Marvel takes a sip of actual hot tea and sighs with deep contentment.
sfx: gentle wand ping; kettle whistle; horn toot; contented sigh

camera: Medium shot of Tomkin at the head of the table
action: Tomkin sets down his reward on his mirror-polished table — grilled sea bass with mint-choc-chip ice cream — lifts his fork and looks around at the crowded table.
action_ext: Tomkin gestures at each companion with his fork as he speaks.
dialogue: Tomkin: You know something, Marvel. The dog still smells like the bottom of a very enthusiastic lake. | Tomkin: Ben has blown his horn seventeen times since we sat down.
sfx: plate set down; fork clink; cosy crackle

camera: Slow push-in on Tomkin, then Marvel with his mug
action: Tomkin speaks more softly, almost against his will, a small smile tugging at his whiskers.
action_ext: Marvel lowers his steaming mug, touched, eyes twinkling.
dialogue: Tomkin: We saved twelve squirrels with tickling, salmon, gingerbread and a dog with two speeds. I think that means we're a good team. | Marvel the Wizard: Marvel accepts the compliment. He finds it unexpectedly touching.
sfx: steam; gentle ambience

camera: Quick comic shot-reverse-shots
action: Holly flutters up hopefully beside Tomkin's ice cream; Tomkin doesn't even look up.
action_ext: Ben pops up on the other side, waving his horn hopefully; Tomkin still doesn't look up.
dialogue: Princess Holly: Could I have a tiny bit of the ice cream? Just the mint part? | Tomkin: No. | Ben Elf: Just one spoonful? I blew my horn nineteen times encouragingly! | Tomkin: No.
sfx: spoon clink

characters: duggie tomkin marvel holly ben squirrels gary
camera: Duggie in the window, then a slow pan across everyone staring
action: Duggie's huge face squashes against the window, begging at hyper speed; Tomkin wraps his arms around his bowl.
action_ext: Silence. Marvel, Holly, Ben, Duggie, twelve squirrels and Gary all stare at Tomkin. Tomkin stares back — then sighs the sigh of a defeated cat.
dialogue: Duggie: CAN-I-HAVE-SOME-I-SAVED-SQUIRRELS-CAN-GARY-HAVE-SOME! | Tomkin: No one is having any. Every single scoop. Mine.
sfx: nose squeak on glass; long heavy sigh

camera: Close on the bowls, then a long pull-back out of the window
action: Tomkin gets out more bowls and portions the ice cream with scientific precision — his own share clearly the largest — and sets a tiny thimble by the wall socket for Gary. Ben blows his horn.
action_ext: The camera pulls out through the window: the lighthouse beam sweeps across the Forgotten Sea, Wi-Fi rings drift to the dreaming dolphins, and far above, the Neon Nebula glows with colour again.
dialogue: Tomkin: If anyone tells anyone, I'll recalibrate the Stink-o-Meter. | Ben Elf: 'The cat shared his ice cream!' ELF GENEROSITY ALERT!
sfx: scoops; bowl clinks; horn toot; waves; gentle beacon hum
